source_title: MICHELLE WIECZOREK JOINS AVO AS SVP, CLINICAL SALES ENABLEMENT - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Veteran Healthcare Executive Brings Decades of Experience in Clinical Documentation Integrity and Revenue Cycle Transformation
NEW YORK , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Avo , the clinical intelligence platform that brings clinical evidence and patient context into the clinician workflow, today announced that Michelle Wieczorek, RN, RHIT, CPHQ, CCDS-O , has joined the company as SVP, Clinical Sales Enablement. A registered nurse and veteran healthcare executive, Wieczorek brings decades of experience in clinical documentation integrity, clinical operations, and revenue cycle transformation.
In her role, Wieczorek will work closely with Avo's commercial, product and analytics teams to help shape solutions around health systems' clinical and revenue cycle needs. She will also equip Avo's sales team with the clinical knowledge and tools to demonstrate Avo's impact on clinical workflows, patient care and financial performance.
"She is a true wizard in driving value by doing care correctly. We are blessed to have someone with her depth of experience joining Avo as we continue to scale," said Yair Saperstein, MD, MPH , co-founder and CEO at Avo. "Michelle's experience will be invaluable to both our team and our partners as we help health systems improve care and strengthen their financial performance."
Wieczorek joins Avo with decades of experience in clinical documentation integrity, revenue cycle transformation, and clinical operations. She most recently served as Executive Vice President, Product and Clinical Operations at Sage Clinical RCM. Previously, she served as System Director, Clinical Documentation Integrity at Hospital Sisters Health System, where she led CDI across a 13-hospital system, and as Senior Vice President, Coding & Clinical Integrity Practice at CSI Companies. She also holds two healthcare patents.
"Avo has developed groundbreaking technology to help health systems improve quality, revenue, and compliance at the point of care, and I'm excited to help bring it to more organizations," said Wieczorek. "I've spent my career working closely with clinical and revenue cycle teams and have seen firsthand what health systems need. I see Avo's clinical intelligence platform as the future of how we support informed care decisions and accurately document the full complexity of care. I'm looking forward to bringing my experience and relationships to Avo and helping our partners achieve better clinical and financial outcomes."
About Avo Avo is the clinical intelligence platform that brings clinical evidence and patient context into the clinician workflow, helping health systems improve quality, revenue, and compliance at the point of care. Integrated with leading EHRs, Avo unifies patient data, trusted clinical knowledge, and health system guidance into AI-powered workflows that help clinicians make more informed care decisions and ensure documentation accurately reflects the complexity of care. By putting clinical evidence to work in real time, Avo helps health systems move beyond retrospective documentation, coding, and revenue cycle processes. Avo partners with more than 60 healthcare organizations, including VCU Health, Marathon Health, MSU Health Care, Emanate Health, NeighborHealth, Mass General Brigham, PM Pediatric Care, Ozarks Healthcare, and Cibolo Health. Learn more at avomd.com .
